exposure: Women who did not complete EREC pathway
Enhanced recovery after elective caesarean (EREC) pathway
outcome: Reasons for not completing EREC pathway
Antenatal satisfaction with preparation for early discharge
cohort: Eligible women enrolled from antenatal clinics
finding: While obstetric and medical factors were the most common reasons for not completing the EREC pathway, women who did not complete EREC had higher antenatal stress levels.
